spans.text: We will look at four arithmetic operators for number calculations. They include:
Addition | + | The combination of two or more numbers to find the total
Subtraction | − | The difference between two numbers
Multiplication | × | The product of repeated addition of a number
Division | / | The separation of a number into equal parts
Look at the following examples for using each arithmetic operator in an algorithm.
